method: Fixed-order nonpreemptive work segments, phase dependencies and calendar-hour lags. Weekdays 09:00–13:00 exclude fixed organisational events. Segment order and sizes are fixed to the candidate: this evaluates one order, not the global optimum. TF/FF are elapsed calendar hours; available-working-hour TF is also reported. Launch target equals the earliest finish under these constraints.
reserve_treatment: Contingency intervals are consumable, not fixed blocks. Late starts may consume reserve: do not add individual floats or claim all contingency remains available after shifting work. Reserve allocation and consumption need separate tracking.
